description: This file defines a utility for creating and managing a NWBrowser instance to discover network services using Bonjour. It provides a single function makeBrowser that sets up the browser with specified parameters and handlers for state updates and results, running it on a dispatch queue.

methods.name: makeBrowser
methods.description: Creates and configures a NWBrowser to discover Bonjour services with specified service type and domain, setting handlers for state and results updates, and running on a specified dispatch queue.
